name: TextFly
tagline: Text a number to get flight-delay predictions and travel answers, with no app.

awards: Best Use of Vibe Kanban by Vibe Kanban

problem: Flight delays surged during a government shutdown, and travellers lacked quick answers.
solution: A multi-agent pipeline answers travel questions by text, predicting delays from social data and checking weather.
demo_moment: Team-described: text your flight number and get a delay prediction.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Exploring Hybrid Intelligence by Photon” and “Best Use of Vibe Kanban by Vibe Kanban” among 195 submissions.
Timely: built during a real disruption.

lessons: SMS-only tools demo instantly on anyone's phone.
